name: p1-kit-wolf-roof
eval: (async()=>{const g=window.__game,c=g.ctx,S=c.society;S.toggleDebug();const sc=S.d.scenarios['wolf_roof'];const cr=c.creatures.byId(sc.creature);for(let i=0;i<200&&cr.place.roof&&!cr.homed;i++){c.player.teleport(cr.home.clone().add({x:20,y:30,z:0}));g.step(2);await new Promise(q=>setTimeout(q,0));}const a=S.forceScenario('wolf_roof',true);const V=c.player.position.constructor;const up=c.player.update.bind(c.player);const hold=c.player.position.clone();const hm=c.player.mode;c.player.update=(dt)=>{up(dt);c.player.position.copy(hold);c.player.mode=hm;c.player.velocity.set(0,0,0);};for(let i=0;i<420&&a&&!a.done;i++){g.step(1);const v=a.pos.clone().sub(c.camera.position);c.player.yaw=Math.atan2(-v.x,-v.z);c.player.pitch=Math.atan2(v.y,Math.hypot(v.x,v.z));if(i%20==0)await new Promise(q=>setTimeout(q,0));}})()
